export_info.description: Read-only export of every implemented Wanderer card, plus the class-agnostic neutral cards the Wanderer can obtain (flagged pool_class = neutral). card_text is the rules text a real CardView shows outside a fight (deck view / reward screen): no stance, 0 Toll, no conditional highlighted; an HP price is shown on the face's separate HP line (face_hp_line), not in the text. Numbers that move in battle are listed under dynamic_values with their rule and this default.
export_info.generated: 2026-10-04, from the live data at HEAD 9fc9509
generated_from: res://battle/card_view.tscn (face text, type label, HP line, rules size)
export_info.rarity: CardData.rarity: COMMON, UNCOMMON, RARE or ULTRA_RARE (no card is Ultra Rare yet). A pool decides whether a card can drop; rarity only how often among the ones that can. RewardPool.weights is empty in both pools (every entry weight 1.0).
export_info.keeper: The Keeper (field/keeper.tscn) now offers keepsakes, not cards, so no card is in a Keeper pool and in_keeper_pool is gone.
export_info.rules_font_px: The size the card's rules text fits at: the first of 15, 14, 13, 12 px that fits; no card overflows 12.
export_info.upgrades: No upgrade system exists in the current project (CardData has no upgrade fields); upgrade_data is null on every card.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Energy
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Per-turn resource that pays a card's cost; 3 per turn.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Toll
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Gained when you lose HP to your own effects. Up to 5 carries over after a fight. Self-inflicted losses only (self-damage, status ticks, stance prices), never enemy hits. Spent by Reckoning, Debt Forgiven, Come Due and Leverage; spending it brings a Sentence a turn closer.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Grace
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: After enemy hits get through your Block, damage you deal on your next turn wins HP back, up to the largest hit. Wanderer passive; lost at the end of that turn. Self-damage never opens it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Critical
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: At or below 30% of your max HP. (CharacterData.critical_hp_fraction 0.3.) Checked live when an effect resolves.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Drain
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Heal for the HP the damage takes from enemies, up to the Drain's number if it has one. Ransom's turn and The Return's trigger Drain.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Spent
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Removed for the rest of this fight once played. Back in the deck next fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Block
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Absorbs damage before HP; resets at the start of your turn. Last Resort prevents gaining it.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Self-damage
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Bypasses block and absorb, makes Toll, opens no Grace, can kill (Down Payment's never takes you below 1).

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Stance
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: One stance type at a time, for the rest of the fight. Another copy of the held stance adds a stack; a different stance replaces it at 1. Played stance cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Power
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Applies a lasting status for the fight; coexists with the stance and other powers. Played power cards leave the deck's rotation for the fight.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Attack bonus
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Flat extra damage from the stance (x stacks) and Dying Light, paid once per Attack card on its first damage effect - Reckoning included.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Marks (Come Due)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: A status on an enemy that adds damage to your next N Attacks against it, once per card per enemy, spending a charge each.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Cost changes
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Leverage: the next card costing at least 1 Energy costs 2 less; the House Key's free card is the same kind of next-card discount; 0-cost cards pass both by. Collateral: the next card costing 2 or more costs 5 HP (paid like self-damage) instead of Energy. Each is spent by the card it changes.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Countdown (Sentence)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: A status on an enemy that deals its damage when the turns run out; spending Toll takes a turn off.

keywords_and_mechanics.name: Braced (enemy)
keywords_and_mechanics.rule: Brace's debuff: the enemy's next Attack deals 50% less, every hit; gone once that Attack resolves.

cards.card_text:
Deal 8 damage.
Then lose 2 HP.

effects.plain_english: Deal 8 damage to the target.
Lose 2 HP: bypasses block and absorb, makes 1 Toll per HP lost, opens no Grace, and can kill.

dynamic_values.rule: Attacks add the attack bonus once per card, on its first damage effect: the held stance's bonus x stacks (Self-Eater +3; Last Resort +6 while Critical) plus Dying Light (+3 per stack while Critical). A Come Due mark on the target adds +4 against that enemy, once per card, spending a charge. Self-Eater also costs 2 HP per stack on each Attack, shown on the face's HP line.

In order: House Key's free card (a keepsake), then Leverage's 2 off (never below 0) - both land on and are spent by the next card costing at least 1 Energy, so a 0-cost card leaves them waiting - then Collateral on what's left: a card still costing 2 or more costs 5 HP instead of Energy. The face shows the cost it would be paid at.

In order: House Key's free card (a keepsake), then Leverage's 2 off (never below 0) - both land on and are spent by the next card costing at least 1 Energy, so a 0-cost card leaves them waiting - then Collateral on what's left: a card still costing 2 or more costs 5 HP instead of Energy. The face shows the cost it would be paid at.
